controls.conclusion: each of the three tests returned 'tradeoff' on synthetic tradeoff data and 'none' on both independent and synergistic data, so each can produce either verdict and none is a constant; and on a perfect tradeoff between a continuous criterion and a three-valued one, no test denied it -- the regime in which the conditional test was previously a proven constant
